title: 偷鱼大作战
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve precise-object-edit. Asset type: self-owned runtime frozen-master candidate. Image 1 is the edit target and controls the entire output, including the improved natural forehead and softened brow tension of the woman. Image 2 is only a geometric reference for the exact large diameter of both cat eyes; do not copy its protruding eyeball depth or stronger forehead creases. Restore both tuxedo-cat eyes to the same very large round size seen in Image 2. Do not make the eyes smaller. Change only the eyeball depth and eyelid integration: recess both globes naturally into the sockets, wrap the eyelids around them, and remove the forward-popping, bead-like or bulging appearance. The cat must look endearingly startled and comical rather than ugly, uncanny or distressed; preserve its black-and-white identity, large pupils, fisheye facial width, nose, muzzle and grip on the fish. Preserve Image 1's woman exactly: natural smooth central forehead without visible veins or an excessive pinched frown, while still urgent, angry, open-mouthed and reaching forward. Keep the fish, extreme wide-angle composition, market street, flying paper, pigeons, lighting, crop and all other details unchanged. Keep the exact 9:16 portrait composition. No text, logo, watermark or signature.
